PDFJ.Title: Import PDF as Journal
PDFJ.DropHint: Click or drop a PDF file here

Field.Name: Journal name
Field.PagesHint: Leave empty to import every page. Example: 1-10, 15, 20-
Field.ColumnModeHint: Faithful: keeps columns and column breaks exactly as in the PDF. Flowing: text reflows between columns when the window is resized.
Field.RemoveHeaders: Remove running headers, footers and page numbers
Field.JoinHyphens: Join words hyphenated at line ends
Field.TransparentHint: Images that are already transparent in the PDF keep their transparency. For the others, the flat background touching the edges is removed; photos and framed illustrations are left untouched.
Field.SkipRepeatedHint: Images repeated on many pages (frames, flourishes) are left out.
Field.GroupByHint: By section: each book heading becomes a journal page and untitled pages join the previous section. By page: one journal page per PDF page.
Field.JoinContinuationsHint: A paragraph the book split at a page break (end of the last column, start of the next page's first column) is joined back. In flowing column mode, this also applies between columns.
Field.LinkReferencesHint: References to book pages become links to the matching part of the journal. Works across chapters imported separately, as long as they come from the same PDF file.

ImageSource.Name: File source
ImageSource.Hint: FilePicker source where images are stored (usually "data").

ImageDirectory.Name: Image folder
ImageDirectory.Hint: Folder for extracted images. Empty: worlds/<world>/pdf-as-journal
